name: /handoff
description: Prepare or record a strict project-local cross-provider handoff

steps.action: Orient read-only and prepare a strict handoff packet
steps.context: Resolve the exact work item, revision, designated base, candidate SHA, reservation state, capability and registry digests, evidence hashes, closed gates, and first verification step. Present the packet without writing. A handoff never grants authority and is local-only by default.

options: B) Request a one-time guarded local handoff recording capability

steps.context: If A, stop with zero writes. If B, prepare the exact orchestrate_work_item.py handoff arguments and capability request. Record only after the registered guarded executor accepts the exact current capability. Never push, deploy, synchronize, or promote.
